title: Chapter 233: The Hub Of The World
content:
Chapter 233: The Hub Of The World

As for whether the Chu State can maintain the current vigorous development of forces, the victory or defeat of the coalition forces in the central battlefield has become crucial again.

If the coalition forces win, even as long as they remain undefeated, the results of Chu's battle can be maintained. If the coalition army loses, then not only will the results of Chu's battle be vomited, but a large piece of territory will also be lost.

At this critical moment, how could Tian Guang hope that he would join the alliance army where the country is located and be defeated?

That's why Tian Guang agreed to Xiaoyaozi to come to the front line of the battlefield with the Mo family who has become extremely at odds with him now, and take a good look at the person he holds grudges and doesn't want him to lose.

In particular, this army is still the main force of the entire alliance, shouldering the important responsibility of resisting Qin's positive pressure, and it is even more critical to the survival of the alliance.

It can be said that even if the alliance is completely defeated on the northern front and the southern front, it doesn't matter. As long as the central front maintains a winning posture, or even just maintains a tie, the alliance can continue to exist.

Because everyone knows that the two fronts in the north and the south are just partial troops from both camps. Although they are more important to the overall situation, they are not fatal.

Why do you say that? Because Zhao and Wei countries in the north, even if all their current soldiers and horses are defeated, they still have more than 100,000 or even 200,000 soldiers and horses in their country, and it is another hero to pull them out.

As for the state of Chu in the south, let alone, it is not impossible to force him to have millions of troops.

These two fronts have such confidence, and naturally have little impact on the outcome, but the coalition forces in the central region are different.

The coalition forces in the central region are composed of the three kingdoms of Yan Kingdom, South Korea, and Yuguo. Yanguo and Yuguo are located in the northern border, thousands of miles away from the battlefield.

With such a long distance, it can be said that it is a dream to mobilize troops from the rear to go south for support.

Even with Yuguo's mobilization ability, plus one man and two horses, it would take him more than a month to arrive as cavalry going south in the starry night. If it was replaced by infantry, it would not take more than three months. Don't even think about it.

For such a long time, it is naturally impossible to count on them to support the battlefield where every moment is extremely precious. In other words, at the very beginning, the support behind the two countries in the central battlefield began to be completely eliminated.

As for South Korea, don't think about it. South Korea is too small, with a total of only a dozen cities. Now that it is being ravaged by the Qin State again, South Korea itself has recruited a group of strong men, and it has long been broken and can no longer be broken.

Now the entire country, because it is more than two years of war, does not know if there are 400,000 people in total, and most of them are old and weak women and children. I don’t know if there are men over ten years old?

Today's 50,000 Korean troops on the battlefield are already the last bit of potential in the country drawn by King Han gritted his teeth, containing the last blood of South Korea.

If these 50,000 people are all dead, it can be said that there is no more man in South Korea.

After all, Korean boys under the age of ten cannot be called men. As for those above the age of ten, because of the war, they have long been dragged into cannon fodder and exhausted.

Today's central coalition forces can be said to have no support at all. Only these people on the battlefield will die if they die, and if they die, they will disappear at all.

That's why it is said that the coalition forces in the central region cannot be defeated, because once they are defeated, the Qin army can rush into the Central Plains from the central region, and the rear of the three kingdoms of Zhao, Wei and Chu will also be completely opened to Qin, without any defense, just open in Qin. before.

Especially Wei Guo, just behind South Korea, and located in the Central Plains, without the defense of the natural dangers of the Yellow River and Huaihe River.

He put the greatest pressure on Qin, so Wei Wang immediately made the decision to go south to support after a little reminder from his prime minister.

Then this principle, once the coalition forces know, Qin will also know, so Qin will bet all his elites on the central battlefield. I just hope that King Jian, the military god of Qin, can live up to his reputation and lead the Qin army to victory again!

As long as the central battlefield is opened, the coalition forces will fall apart, and the current situation of North and South echoing each other and uniting each other will no longer be the same.

Instead, they will be defeated by the elite Qin Jun who freed up their hands in the middle, and will fall back to the previous situation again, even worse than before.

Because of this war, all countries have consumed all their foundations. Now that they lose, they will no longer be able to resist Qin's aggression.

As for Qin, it can be regarded as unifying more than half of China. In addition to Qi and Chu, the other Han, Zhao, Wei, Jin, and Yan in the north can all be obtained at your fingertips.

The Chu State in the south will also lose a large piece of territory, and can only huddle in the Jiangdong area, lingering on its last breath.

On the top of the mountain, the Taoist, Mohist and peasant families have their own thoughts and plans. But there is no doubt that they all have a common purpose, or a common belief, that is, the coalition forces cannot lose.

Among the allied forces, Yan State represented the interests of the Mohists, Chu State represented the interests of the farmers, and as for the Renzong of the Taoists, they were constantly entangled with the Three Kingdoms of Han, Zhao, and Wei.

Each of their schools has an interest in the coalition. If the coalition loses, the impact on their schools will be enormous, and it may even cause their schools to collapse.

So no matter what they think of the coalition forces, or how they look at the coalition forces, they have no intention of fighting against the coalition forces, but secretly support the coalition forces.

This can be seen from the strong men they sent to accompany the army, as well as secretly helping the coalition forces resist the Jianghu forces from the Qin faction, and even face the snare weapons of Qin directly.

These rivers and lakes schools, various schools of thought, for the coalition forces they support, can be said to have done their best.

"The war has already begun, I don't know, who is the winner of this battle?" Xiaoyaozi's mysterious voice came over, looking like a magic stick.

They, the so-called Taoists, pursue the so-called way of heaven, and they like to pretend to be gods and ghosts. Regarding everything, they say to speculate on God's will and leave everything to heaven to decide.

Even Renzong, who prefers to practice in the world, is unswervingly pursuing the will of heaven, but the method is different from Tianzong.

Tian Guang frowned, he didn't like these Taoists, they were too pretentious, pursuing the ethereal way of heaven, not pragmatic. But he still turned his head and looked down the hill.

There, the battle that has gathered hundreds of thousands of people is about to start.

The outcome of this battle will affect the balance of strength between the two sides, and the inclination of the world situation is very important to Tian Guang and even the people of the world.
